records.title: SBI Shinsei Trust JPYSC issuance and reserve composition as of 30 September 2026
records.note: Current issuer page reports issue value JPY20,070,668,515 and trust property JPY20,101,088,515 as of 2026-09-30. Composition: ordinary deposits JPY10,303,388,515 (51.26%), time deposits JPY8,800,000,000 (43.78%), Japanese government bonds at market value JPY997,700,000 (4.96%); JGB book value JPY997,290,000 and face value JPY1,000,000,000. Trust property exceeds issue value by JPY30,420,000 (0.15156%, derived). Page says trust assets are segregated from trustee's own property, JPYSC is not legal tender or a deposit and is not covered by deposit insurance, no interest/distribution is paid to holders, and JGB market-price changes can cause principal loss. This is a dynamic issuer page; figures are point-in-time and not a current 30 October balance.

records.title: SBI VC Trade current JPYSC transfer and public-chain availability status
records.note: At capture, SBI VC Trade states JPYSC deposits and withdrawals are not supported. Public-chain circulation is conditional on clarification of relevant laws/tax practice and regulatory confirmation. Marketing descriptions of payments, transfers and public-chain utility are explicitly future-state conditional. This is a current operational restriction, not evidence of external-wallet or public-chain settlement.

records.title: SBI VC Trade September 2026 custody-balance growth ranking
records.note: SBI VC Trade ranks RLUSD first, JPYSC second and TON third for September 2026 custody-balance growth. No absolute balances, growth percentages, XRP rank or gross/net customer flows are disclosed. This is a relative company-published ranking, not an independently audited adoption or capital-flow series.
